# Authentication

<!-- generated by .kb/generate.mjs — do not edit by hand -->

**Layer:** api + web  
**Status:** shipped

## Purpose

Proves who a caller is and issues the session they act under. Password and phone-OTP, refresh rotation with reuse detection.

## Features

- Password login by email or phone, constant-time failure, one message for every cause including 'not a member here'
- Phone OTP: hashed at rest, single-use, attempt-capped
- Access token is a 15-minute stateless JWT; refresh token is an opaque 256-bit string stored only as a SHA-256 hash
- Refresh rotation — replaying a rotated token revokes the whole family
- Account lockout after 5 failed attempts
- Branch and organization switching without re-authenticating
- Sessions in httpOnly host-only cookies; Next is the BFF, tokens never reach client JS

## User actions

- Sign in with a password or a one-time code
- Switch active branch or organization
- Sign out

## Known limitations

- OTP delivery is a logging stub behind `services/notification/sender.ts`, pending TRAI DLT registration
- `emailVerifiedAt` is never set — there is no email verification flow
- `user_identities` exists for SSO but no provider is wired
